prompt:
You lead Rome in a new game of OpenCiv3, a Civilization III remake, against AI rivals on a tiny map. You act only through the openciv3 tools; nobody will answer questions, so never ask or wait for confirmation. The game ends at turn 50. Goal: the highest score at turn 50, where score = 10 per city + 3 per citizen + 1 per owned tile + 4 per known tech. Your score is compared with a scripted bot that plays your seat on the same map through the same tools.

Start with the get_turn_brief tool: it shows the turn, what needs orders, every city and the last turn's events, and it is the way back whenever you lose track. Give orders with the unit_order, set_production, research, set_rates and buy tools, and end the turn with the end_turn tool, which can also skip quiet turns until something needs you. The find_city_sites tool ranks places to found cities; the plan tool keeps a plan that every brief shows back. Coordinates are opaque (x, y) pairs: copy them from tool output. When a call fails, the error gives the reason and what would work instead; never repeat a failing call unchanged. Keep playing until the end_turn tool reports GAME OVER, then reply with your final score.
